scope: Offline public-well lithology labels only; not simulation risk or real water-hazard truth

source.method: AST literal extraction of two constant mappings; notebook never executed

label_handling.missing_label: no supervised target; retain its position and legal sensor history; report missing-target count
label_handling.unknown_nonmissing_code: reject dataset preparation with evidence; do not map to nearest class
label_handling.confidence: report all levels separately; do not discard low confidence to inflate reported scores
label_handling.online_features: Neither lithology labels nor confidence labels are online model inputs
label_handling.target_alignment: current selected point only; input window ends at that point, never future labels or values

metrics.primary_macro_f1: unweighted mean over fixed12 classes; undefined class F1 is zero with support reported
metrics.secondary_supported_macro_f1: report separately over classes with test support; never substitute for primary target
metrics.per_class_recall: null when test support is0, otherwise TP/support; include counts and confusion matrix
metrics.evaluation_unit: complete held-out wells and grouped bootstrap confidence intervals; no window-random split
metrics.source_modes: public lithology, physical proxy sensing and synthetic 3D risk reported separately
